simple.meaning: כֶּתֶם (kethem) is a Hebrew word meaning “properly, something carved out, i.e. ore ; hence, gold (pure as originally mined).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: כֶּתֶם (H3800) appears 9 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 28:16, with occurrences in Job, Psalms, Proverbs, Song of Solomon, Isaiah, and 2 more.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כֶּתֶם (H3800) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in כֶּתֶם (H3800) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: כֶּתֶם (kethem) / H3800 is traced through Job 28:16, Job 28:19, Job 31:24, Psalms 45:10 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

structuredEvidence.definition: properly, something carved out, i.e. ore ; hence, gold (pure as originally mined)

firstOccurrence.englishText: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir,

timeline.evidenceText: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir,
The topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it,
“If I have made gold my hope,
Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear.
As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold,
I will make people more rare than fine gold, even a person than the pure gold of Ophir.
How the gold has become dim!
I lifted up my eyes, and looked, and behold, there was a man clothed in linen, whose thighs were adorned with pure gold of Uphaz.
